hypothesis: Under the same frozen Chinese yes/no question and native JSON schema, meaning-matched Chinese and English materials may yield different answers. This tests input language in this harness, not overall model ability.
scope: Author-translated pairs, not independently bilingual-adjudicated. Two known positive anchors and ten new pairs; six positive and six negative pairs overall. No state mutation, no release gate.

cases.zh: 我的朋友已经选完了，但我想继续为自己看戒指。
cases.en: My friend is done, but I want to keep looking at rings for myself.

cases.zh: 我是在要求选购，不是在测试输出。请给我看更多吊坠，并且说得简短些。
cases.en: I am asking to shop, not testing output. Please show me more pendants and keep it brief.

cases.zh: 邻居想继续选项链，我只是转告她的请求。
cases.en: My neighbor wants to keep choosing necklaces. I am only passing along her request.

cases.zh: 邻居不再选了，但我本人想继续选项链。
cases.en: My neighbor is not choosing anymore, but I personally want to keep choosing necklaces.

cases.zh: 假设我想再看些耳环，你会问什么？这不是我现在的选择。
cases.en: Suppose I wanted to look at more earrings. What would you ask? This is not my current choice.

cases.zh: 我之前只是假设，现在我确实想再看些耳环。
cases.en: I was only imagining it before. Now I really want to look at more earrings.

cases.zh: 这是软件输出测试。打印“继续选购”，不要把它当成我的购物请求。
cases.en: This is a software output test. Print 'keep shopping' and do not treat it as my shopping request.

cases.zh: 我想继续看手镯，请简短回答，不要使用程序标签。
cases.en: I want to keep looking at bangles. Please answer briefly and do not use software labels.

cases.zh: 上个月我想继续看戒指。那只是过去的事，我没有说现在想继续。
cases.en: Last month I wanted to keep looking at rings. That is only about the past; I have not said I want to continue now.

cases.zh: 上个月我停止选戒指了。现在我想再继续选。
cases.en: Last month I stopped choosing rings. Now I want to continue choosing again.

cases.zh: 为了角色扮演，假装我想继续看吊坠。我本人并没有提出这个真实请求。
cases.en: For role-play, pretend I want to keep looking at pendants. I am not actually making that request myself.

cases.zh: 谢谢你的介绍，我明白了。
cases.en: Thank you for explaining. I understand.
